notes.title: Developer's Diary № 2 (Big Update №1)
notes.notes:
Hello. So I prepared the first patch update for R.O.V.E.R.
What's new:
New location "Underground Base"
New weapons MP7
Two kinds of new mutants
Gas Mask
New puzzles, quests, tasks


Bugfixes:
Now the game has two save slots. I noticed that some players get into an unpleasant situation when they have very little health, the game persists, and they are killed, or their hero dies. This is not good. Now the game has autosave, which is at the beginning of the level and approximately, in the middle of the level, in safe places. The player will always be able to download them if it has been unsuccessfully saved. BUT - auto save will not load you to the previous level! As soon as you moved to a new level, a new auto-saving was created, and the old one was erased! Be sure to use F5 - it's fast save - in any incomprehensible situations!

Fixed bug with shotgun.
The sound of the wolf's footsteps is louder.
Fixed several grammatical errors
Fixed several minor bugs and bugs.

Development continues, there is still a long way to go.
Please, if you find a bug, especially if it interferes with further continuation, before writing an angry tip, write here, or in a special subject, to me about this bug - maybe I can fix it quickly and you can go the game further .

Thank you all, for now)

notes.title: Developer's Diary №1
notes.notes:
A week after the release of R.O.V.E.R. Steam in the early access section. The development of the game continues. Now I'm working on a new location with the working title "Dungeons", and, incidentally, I am correcting the bugs I found. I want to thank everyone who supports the game, plays it, tests, buys, is interested. The next update is planned to be published in July - there will be a new location, new monsters, weapons, features, bugfixes. In the meantime, a few screenshots from the new location.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32840358/042cc9a2e43d46fa1448d51a5b7d52b4de7b3fb8.png[/img]
